name: Isoklo
description: Your unit tests passed. The agent deleted the assertions. Isoklo blocks it in 2 seconds. A deterministic merge gate for AI-written pull requests: 62 fixed rules, no model, no YAML. It blocks deleted or skipped tests, packages that do not exist, leaked secrets, hidden agent instructions, risky MCP servers and out-of-scope edits, with the exact line as evidence and a signed receipt. Free for public repositories. https://euklo.com/isoklo
